transcript:
Meeting Header
Date: 2026-10-05
Start: 09:30 PT   Duration: ~55 minutes
Attendees: Samir Patel / Jenna Ortiz / Luis Fernandez / Asha Kumar / Ben Wallace / Maya Singh / Tom Riley

Summary:
Quick ops sync between IT, Finance and Security to align on upcoming audit evidence, billing/tagging cleanup, maintenance window for infra patching, and a small internal POC requiring reserved GPU time. Conversation touches on KMS key rotation, SSO/SAML setup, billing export formats, and SOC 2 evidence scoping.

Topics:
- SOC 2 evidence & audit dry-run
- Billing/cost center tagging and invoice mapping
- Patch/maintenance windows and rollback plan
- Short POC for elevated GPU access for ML infra team
- SSO and service-account permissions review

Transcript:
[00:00] Samir: hey everyone thanks for squeezing this in, um quick check we can start, does this time still work for folks?
[00:08] Asha: yeah this is fine, just have my calendar open; Ben pinged earlier about the billing mapping
[00:15] Ben: yup, I've got the export but wanted to confirm the tag keys we're all expecting; last quarter there were a bunch of mis-tagged resources
[00:24] Jenna: also FYI security wants to rotate some service keys next week so there might be a short auth blip if we don't coordinate
[00:32] Maya: yep, we will need the list of service accounts that use the old KMS key — and the timeline for rotation, otherwise audits will flag it
[00:40] Samir: great, so agenda: SOC2 packet share, billing tags, patch window, and then the small infra POC that needs reserved pool; wanna tackle SOC2 first

[01:05] Samir: I uploaded the current evidence pack to the shared drive but it's missing the new change control logs from IT for Sep, Asha can you confirm
[01:12] Asha: ah right, the change control entries were delayed because of the monthly maintenance, I'll pull the logs and drop them in today
[01:20] Ben: when you drop them can you use the csv format? our finance automation parses csv vs json so it makes reconciliation easier
[01:27] Asha: sure csv is fine, i'll put a note in the file
[01:34] Maya: also on that note the encryption section needs a KMS key rotation proof for the last 12 months
[01:40] Asha: we rotated keys in Feb and again in Aug; i can assemble the key rotation history export but it's a bit messy in the console
[01:48] Samir: if you can scrub PII and share the history that should be sufficient for the auditor; we should add a one-line explanation about why the Aug rotation happened — it was scheduled maintenance not a compromise

[02:15] Ben: about billing tags — what are the canonical tag keys? last time some teams used costCenter vs cost_center and it broke the pipeline
[02:23] Luis: from product finance we agreed on cost_center, environment, and project_code, everything else is optional
[02:30] Ben: ok I'll map costCenter -> cost_center in our export and send over a cleaned CSV
[02:36] Samir: good, please include resource ARNs where possible so we can do a quick sampling

[03:05] Maya: on SSO, we need to confirm SAML metadata for Okta and that the assertion consumer URL is correct — otherwise users will see login failures during key rotation
[03:13] Jenna: i've got the new metadata but haven't pushed it; is this when we want to do the rotation? we should avoid peak hours
[03:20] Asha: maintenance window this month is Friday 02:00-04:00 UTC; that's our low traffic window
[03:28] Tom: legal just wants confirmation that there will be an audit trail retained for 90 days for any changes made in that window
[03:34] Maya: yes retention is configured but i'll verify the config, some logs were set to 30d accidentally on the dev account
[03:40] Samir: ok adjust dev to 90d and record that change, and Asha please provide the rollback playbook

[04:05] Ben: quick question about the internal POC — the ML infra team needs a small reserved GPU pool for a week; is that something finance can approve fast?
[04:13] Luis: cost center can approve but we need to see the expected spend; if it's under $2k we can do a quick internal approval
[04:20] Ben: it's estimated at about $1.6k for the week
[04:24] Samir: sounds fine, but security wants the instance isolation documented — are we using dedicated tenancy or shared?
[04:31] Jenna: for the POC we can spin up a dedicated instance group with isolated VPC; should be fine for short term
[04:37] Maya: i want to ensure no sensitive corp data is used in that POC and that logging is enabled
[04:42] Ben: confirm, we will use synthetic data set and enable full audit logging

[05:10] Asha: i'll compile the change control logs and key rotation history today and drop links; expect by EOD
[05:16] Samir: perfect, Ben will send the cleaned billing csv by Friday
[05:21] Ben: yes i'll send it and include a mapping table
[05:25] Jenna: i'll run a quick inventory of service accounts and get it to the channel by tomorrow
[05:30] Maya: i'll verify log retention settings and update the security doc
[05:34] Tom: legal will prepare the audit checklist for the dry-run

[05:50] Samir: any blocker items? if not let's recap next steps
[05:54] Asha: no blockers; just need to know who to tag on the drop
[05:57] Samir: tag Samir and Maya and finance

Recap / Next steps:
- Samir to upload SOC2 compliance packet and new evidence links (by 2026-10-06)
- Asha to provide change control logs + KMS key rotation history (by 2026-10-08)
- Ben to send cleaned billing CSV with resource ARNs and mapping (by 2026-10-08)
- Jenna to inventory service accounts and share permissions list (by 2026-10-07)
- Maya to confirm log retention and update security doc (by 2026-10-08)
- Schedule audit dry-run: proposed 2026-10-20 (Samir to schedule)

Links shared:
- SOC2 evidence folder: https://drive.internal/redwood/soc2-evidence (Samir)
- Billing export template: https://docs.internal/redwood/billing-template.csv (Ben)

End of transcript
